payload.title: Plain-MQTT publishers still connect with the sensor_service account and publish on legacy free-text topics; each must move to its own issued sensor principal (ADR-047 section 7) before the legacy namespaces and their client IDs leave sensor_service
evidence: infrastructure/simulators/nodered/flows/sensor-simulator.json:198 (repo simulator connects as sensor_service with clientid nodered-simulator and publishes sensors/farm-01/... streams)
apps/sensor-service/src/edge-device/mqtt-auth.service.ts:400 (sensor_service holds publish grants under sensor/, sensors/ and aquaculture/)
apps/sensor-service/src/ingestion/mqtt-listener.service.ts:79 (the listener subscribes the legacy sensors/#, aquaculture/+/sensors/# and +/+/+/temperature-array filters)
payload.rule_violated: ADR-047 section 7: sensors registered before the ADR keep their topics until moved to an issued identity; a tracked finding with an owner and deadline lists them
payload.notes: Registered with the broker client-ID bindings. On 2026-10-30 the production broker log shows one more publisher: client nodered-codex-sim-01 connects as sensor_service (the codex-sim Node-RED compose under /var/lib/aqua/simulators, topic sensors/codex-test/water-temp-01). Each listed publisher's client ID stays reserved to sensor_service until it moves to an issued principal.
